You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

Based on the chest X-rays provided, which of the following statements most accurately describes the progression of the largest cavity in the right lower lobe and its relationship to other findings over the course of the patient's follow-up?  
A) The largest cavity in the right lower lobe increased in size and developed new air-fluid levels, while the surrounding consolidation worsened significantly.  
B) The largest cavity in the right lower lobe decreased in size with reduction of the air-fluid level, and the surrounding consolidation improved significantly.  
C) The largest cavity in the right lower lobe remained the same size but developed additional air-fluid levels, with no change in surrounding consolidation.  
D) The largest cavity in the right lower lobe decreased in size without a change in the air-fluid level, and the surrounding consolidation remained unchanged.  
E) The largest cavity in the right lower lobe increased in size and the air-fluid level resolved, with progression of the surrounding consolidation.  
F) The largest cavity in the right lower lobe decreased in size with a reduction of the air-fluid level, but the surrounding consolidation did not change.
